rule: Publish a dedicated Backtesting page for every locked book whose full-sample after-costs CAGR is ≥ 15%.
note: Archived because the locked full-sample CAGR clears 15%, not because a book is preferred. Dual momentum is not a substitute for the H4 Donchian page.
howToReplace: Add a book object here when a new locked research book clears the 15% CAGR archive rule, and add a matching route under /backtesting/{slug} with JSON in public/data/backtesting/{slug}/.
